description: This file defines an abstract assertion class for inspecting and validating instances of ThingModifyCommand in a testing context, providing methods to assert the presence or absence of an entity within such commands.

classes.name: AbstractThingModifyCommandAssert
classes.description: An abstract assertion class for verifying properties of ThingModifyCommand instances in tests, including methods to check for the presence or absence of an associated entity.

methods.name: withEntity
methods.description: Asserts that the command contains an entity matching expectedEntity; throws an assertion error if not.

methods.name: withoutEntity
methods.description: Asserts that the command does not contain an entity.
